repository_source_rule: Repository source references remain relative to the pinned isolated checkout and are individually SHA-256 bound inside the reviewer records; they can be recovered at the exact baseline commit.
failed_capture_rule: A DNS failure may name an intended capture path without creating a response body. Its error receipt is preserved; absent/empty bodies are not counted as retrieved documents.
preservation_of_previous_evidence: No B1Q/B1R/B1S, B2 or CI-acceptance archive file is overwritten.
